opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Grant of up to £40,000 for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in British art, visual culture and architectural history
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art, visual culture and architectural history.
opportunities.summary: Supports staff costs towards the facilitation of a research project with public‑facing outcomes such as exhibitions, digital projects, catalogues or similar dissemination.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Grant of up to £6,000 for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals seeking to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues or articles on British art.
opportunities.summary: Supports practical publishing costs such as image copyright fees and other expenses related to disseminating research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Grant of up to £6,000 for organisations to produce publications related to exhibitions and displays
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations producing publications linked to their exhibitions and displays.
opportunities.summary: Covers publishing costs such as image and production expenses for exhibition‑related publications.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Grant of up to £5,000 for organisations to digitise collections and make them freely available online
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations seeking to digitise collections for online public access.
opportunities.summary: Supports personnel and equipment costs needed to digitise collections and make them freely available to audiences online.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Grant of up to £3,000 for organisations to disseminate research through live, online and hybrid events
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations wishing to host events (live, online or hybrid) to share research on British art.
opportunities.summary: Covers costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing for events aimed at diverse audiences.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Grant of up to £25,000 for organisations to protect and preserve significant works of British art
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations undertaking original conservation research on significant British art works.
opportunities.summary: Supports staff and equipment costs required for conservation research to protect and preserve important works of British art.
